== Summary ==
Identified: [[Sam Tashima]], [[Ian Campbell]]. First names in the caption; [[Sam Tashima]] and [[Ian Campbell]] are the only Sam and Ian in the event's final standings. The source does not mark which player is which.

== Description ==

[[Sam Tashima]] vs [[Ian Campbell]]. At the [[May 2003 Rochester, Minnesota tournament]], Face the Music, Rochester, Minnesota, 17 May 2003.

== Source and credit ==

Shared by [[Nick Kolnik]] (bluethrawn) on his MNSWCCG website; he announced the pictures on the Players Committee forum in [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=26390#26390 post 26390] in "2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend" (topic 1291), 19 May 2003. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive]. The source does not say who took them.

Published on the MNSWCCG "2003 Minnesota SW:CCG Road to States" page, Event Pictures, 05/17, link "Sam vs. Ian": [http://states.mnswccg.com/road.html states.mnswccg.com/road.html]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040319014922/http://states.mnswccg.com/road.html Internet Archive]
